hydrogen_partner.label: H/H2
hydrogen_partner.geometry_source: NIST CCCBDB; bundled H/H2 catalogue geometry

extraction: Caldeweyher et al., JCP 150,154122 (2019), Eq.5; CuH minus charge-scaled H2/2 on the same frequency grid; neutral Cu atom directly.
charge_model: native EEQ for reference charges and extraction scaling
source: Independent vibe-qc RKS/UKS and coupled response; no upstream reference polarizability table copied.
cross_coefficients: Casimir-Polder quadrature against current frozen reference polarizabilities. Cu atomic reference spectra and self coefficients are preserved; cross coefficients follow the light-element protocol when its spectra change.
scope: Neutral Cu atom and monohydride references only. Full Z<=86 coverage and GFN2 total-energy parity remain incomplete.
